title: Conditional κ = 0.001600682403612293: joint-prefix kernels and structural bounds
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Admit **conditional κ = 0.001600682403612293**, **+0.0384301857%** over [PR569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/569). This is an exponent-saving improvement, not a measured runtime speedup.

The construction combines a new 57-gate A prefix (previously 69 gates), four additional cold relations from PR568, and PR569's 32 width-seven promotions. Its local paid-profile change is `-12 H2 + 8 H3`, with the same residual-width inventory. Four explicit helper-label swaps let the 63 selected calls retain PR569's physical geometry; nine plain four-cold calls remain. Dimension 73, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682 and deficit 2560 are unchanged.

The native complex rate is `0.001603248695587935849402`; the conservative assembly separately admits κ `0.001600682400830496`.

New work is confined to `research/structural-gain/`. This PR targets `main` and **depends on unmerged PR569**, so its comparison currently also includes that ancestor's `research/larger-gain/` package. Those 341 manifest-bound artifacts are unchanged. PR569's mathematical source is pinned at `f1db606a1416359229f944946667338305208064`, followed by packaging-only commit `1424da81263a5305b35e4cf74ef686c275f03f3f`. External PR564 is pinned at `c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935`; PR568 at `71c99ac935a33bb7b59a1b4a7af8725a939b0b90`.

The package also records bounded experiments in joint bases, shared gauges, global frame choices and foreign-output borrowing. Removing 28 actual helper paths **without replacement or output-path cost** prices an optimistic **+3.38753%** target. No restoration circuit, physical admission or bit-side composition achieves that target. It is not part of the claimed improvement. The exclusions likewise apply only to their stated models.

Inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape and analytic-transfer assumptions remain. The unchanged PR543 bit supplier is cited and repriced, not freshly rebuilt. No unconditional multiplier theorem, complete Lean proof or general worst-case O(1) indexing result is claimed.

Prepared with substantial **OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra)** assistance in research, implementation, verification and documentation. Source notices, licenses, earlier contributors and contributor-specific AI disclosures are preserved; see `research/structural-gain/NOTICE`.

## Validation

- Fresh **18-stage composition replay** passed: native columns in both orientations, complete phases, literal ownership, invoice, both exact moment engines and both outer models. Prior baseline receipts and pinned inventories are validated and reused, not represented as newly rebuilt.
- Independent **10-stage joint-basis replay** passed, reproducing 35 literal words and exact search records. Frame/factory experiments include optimized-Python checks and targeted rejection controls.
- Full receipts, source pins and reproduction commands accompany each package. All 34 retained Python files parsed. `git diff --check` reports three trailing blank lines in preserved, hash-bound source copies.
- No fresh aggregate `make verify` pass is claimed. During PR569 preparation, `make gen4-bank-verify` passed; broader verification stopped at unavailable Boost headers. No code-review workflow was run, as requested.
